newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sanonda parent profit at $10.24 mln in H1.
newsitem.headline: China's Sanonda parent profit at $10.24 mln in H1.

text.p: The pre-tax profit of China's Sanonda Group, parent company of Hubei Sanonda Co reached 85 million yuan ($10.24 million) in the first half, up 30 percent from a year ago, a company official said on Wednesday.
Sales of the parent company, Sanonda Group, in the central province of Hubei, reached 620 million yuan in the first half, the official said but gave no comparative figures.
Pre-tax profits were expected at 130 million yuan in 1997, sales were estimated at 1.5 billion yuan, and exports would be worth $20 million, he said without giving further details.
